assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Returning without refusal, omitting the fixed approved member or reason, writing any row, or stamping the anchor fails; the parent-state control fails both dry-run and apply.
Removing the batch-wide hold lets another pending row be written before the approved member is refused.
Removing open-roster detection prevents the fixed member and request reason from appearing in the refusal.

findings.text: follow-on: the late batch check uses filter_protected, which recognizes approved names but not an open roster or contested name acquired after the earlier preflight; such a change can leave a protected family partly reconciled.
